raw_market.question: 4Q Spread: Patriots (-6.5)
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the NFL game between Raiders and Patriots, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Patriots" if the Patriots outscore the Raiders by 7 or more points in the fourth quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Raiders".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
